item.title: [IGNITE-1112] Atomic cache #get method returns old value if near cache enabled after second putAll.
item.description:
These tests failed:

GridCacheAtomicNearEnabledMultiJvmFullApiSelfTest.testPutAllPutAll
GridCacheAtomicNearEnabledFairAffinityMultiJvmFullApiSelfTest.testPutAllPutAll

These tests work fine in one jvm, but fails in multi-JVM case.

Looks like, second putAll does not update data at near cache and get method returns old value. But iteration from cache return actual data.

See ignite-648-putAll branch with more debug information.
